title: AQPI-8 4.2 Sort and filter hotel results: asked for in Jira but not implemented in the code

releaseDecision: Does not block the release: gap excluded by Priya Shah at the requirement review.
requirementText: The guest can apply supported filters such as price range, amenities, hotel category, and distance when data is available. The guest can sort using approved options. Selected criteria are visible and removable. Zero results after filtering offer a reset option.

recommendation: Exclude it from this cycle as a gap (a Minor gap defect is raised and the story is picked up again in the next release), or discuss with the developer and the product owner.
